description: This file contains the implementation of functions related to fixing MD5 checksums and editing headers in MTD (Memory Technology Device) images for a specific 'wrgg' header format. It includes functions for reading, modifying, and writing back header and image data in flash storage devices, with specific handling for endianness and checksum validation.

methods.name: uint32_t le32_to_cpu(uint8_t * buf)
methods.description: Converts a 4-byte little-endian buffer to a 32-bit unsigned integer in CPU byte order.

methods.name: int wrgg_fix_md5(struct wrgg03_header * shdr,int fd,size_t data_offset,size_t data_size)
methods.description: Calculates and updates the MD5 checksum in the wrgg header for a specified data region in the flash device.

methods.name: int mtd_fixwrgg(const char * mtd,size_t offset,size_t data_size)
methods.description: Main function to locate a 'wrgg' header in an MTD device, verify, fix the MD5 checksum, and write back the updated header and data.

ctags.name: wrgg_fix_md5
ctags.pattern: /^wrgg_fix_md5(struct wrgg03_header *shdr, int fd, size_t data_offset, size_t data_size)$/
